content:
kai: heads-up — we're seeing a pattern where high-tier eu customers are getting routed to us-west model variants and then tripping fallback cascades. short spike started ~10:12 UTC :eyes:

marta: confirmed. fallback.counter for model_x_q2 -> model_x_q1 jumped 6x. dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/routing/fallbacks?range=15m :fire:

sasha: any deploys or routing rule changes around that time?

kai: no deploys from platform. changed some autoscale knobs yesterday but that wouldn't flip region routing. raw header from a failed request:
```
{x-customer-tier: gold, x-origin-region: eu-west-1, accept-model-variant: model_x_q2, route-policy: tier+region}
response: 502 from us-west-2/model_x_q2 -> fallback to model_x_q1 -> 429 on quota-check -> fallback retry -> loop
```

jon: reading the logs — the smart-router decided eu->us-west because eu pool reported "degraded" for q2 variant. But the fallback policy allowed cross-region fallthrough instead of limiting to regional variants. looks like a policy gap.

leila: we intentionally had cross-region fallback as a soft policy for short bursts. seems that combined with aggressive retry+no-circuit-breaker we get amplification.

marta: immediate mitigation idea: flip the routing flag to prefer regional-only fallbacks for "gold" and "enterprise" tiers + add a short 5s circuit-breaker for variant retries. who can flip?

sasha: i can flip the flag in the control plane. will do a canary: update config on staging router first then prod after 30s.

opsbot: incident INC-4821 created by sasha — "cross-region fallback loop affecting gold customers". Priority: P2.

jon: suggested config diff (quick):
```json
{
  "routing": {
    "fallback_scope": "region_only",
    "tier_overrides": {
      "gold": {"fallback_scope": "region_only"},
      "enterprise": {"fallback_scope": "region_only"}
    },
    "variant_retry_limit": 1,
    "variant_retry_backoff_ms": 5000
  }
}
```

kai: also add telemetry: emit tag "fallback.scope" and increment metric fallback.loop.detected if we see repeated variant->variant cycles within 30s. would help postmortem.

marta: rolling the canary now on staging. will watch fallback.rate and 99p latency.

sasha: staging looks clean after flip. fallback.count down 78% on test replay.

marta: rolling to prod now in two batches. first batch to eu routers only.

jon: monitoring: fallback.counter drop starting at 10:22 UTC. some residual 429s from quota gate — those are real and will need separate mitigation (quota bump or soft-fallback to smaller model).

leila: follow-up action: (1) enforce region-only fallback for paid tiers, (2) implement variant retry circuit-breaker global default, (3) add console alert when cross-region routing exceeds threshold, (4) update docs/rollouts UX to highlight cross-region fallback risk.

kai: thanks. i'll file a small RFC for policy changes and add telemetry ticket.

marta: tagging @oncall for a runbook update. :white_check_mark:

opsbot: incident INC-4821 status -> mitigated. will monitor 1h before close.
